series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 4 of 7

beats.vo: Checking in with her doesn't kill the mood. Going silent and guessing does.

overlay.text: Checking in doesn't kill the mood.

beats.visual_intent: Night city skyline seen from a window, warm interior light, no people.

beats.vo: You don't need a speech. Two quick questions do most of the work: "Is this okay?" and "Do you want to keep going?"
Say it low and easy, in the moment, like it's part of it, because it is.
beats.visual_intent: Warm lamp light on a plain wall, soft shadows, no people.

beats.vo: If the answer is anything less than a clear yes, slow down or stop. No pressure, no sulking.

overlay.text: Less than a clear yes? Slow down.

beats.visual_intent: Rain on a window at night, calm.

beats.vo: Number three is next: the thing you're most scared of, and what to do if it happens.
